en: Black‑and‑white street view of a European city around the turn of the 20th century. The scene shows a broad, tree‑lined avenue with multi‑storey bourgeois townhouses and corner buildings with domes and small spires. On the left are shuttered windows and shopfronts with striped awnings; people walk on the pavement and a few horse‑drawn carriages and handcarts travel along the unpaved road. Well‑dressed pedestrians in long coats and hats stand near a railing in the foreground.
